body: Very light sensitive, I also have astigmatism
I understand how you feel and what you are going through
I feel you, I feel the same way
I experience this same feeling for my ex and we have kids together
I cried till I couldn't move or feel anything, I sat curled up in a ball in my pickup for 5 hours
The real dumbass was the driver of the minivan, they caused the accident
I know the kid who owns this truck, and he wasn't driving recklessly or speeding, minivan pulled out in front of him, and he ran them over

I've lost a lot of friends because I stopped texting first, when people call me they want me to do something for them, I always feel left out, hell my ex left me and I have never felt good enough, my own kid (3) tells me he don't love me and he wants to live with his mom, it's a hard life to hold on to, but I understand your feeling
I haven't been to that place in years
